_schema.questions: Array of { id, question, expected_keywords (lowercased substrings; a correct answer should contain at least min_keywords of them), min_keywords (default 1) }. The corpus is the retrieval-set memories, seeded into a fresh bench DB; for each question the harness recalls top-k context, prompts a local Ollama model, and scores the answer by keyword match and (optionally) an Ollama-as-judge pass.
_schema.notes: Answers are graded leniently by keyword; the judge pass adds a semantic check using the same local model. Both are 100% local.
